fields.label: Trade
fields.description: A Subcontract article — POP, tiling, electrical points. Its basis decides the unit this line is quoted in.

fields.label: Vendor
fields.description: Whose rate this line is priced at. Leave blank and the line falls back to a planning figure, which the rate source will say.

fields.label: Unit
fields.description: From the article's basis. Not typed — two lines disagreeing about the unit is how a quantity stops meaning anything.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: The vendor's price list rate. Read-only here — rates are keyed against the Item, never inside an estimate.

fields.label: Rate From
fields.description: vendor = this vendor's own price. assumed ceiling / another vendor = a stand-in. unset = never priced.

fields.label: Service Item
fields.description: Where the vendor rates for this trade live. Derived from the article.
